_comment: FROZEN commit-channel PreToolUse guard (A6). hooks-ensure-infra.md MERGES this single entry into the consumer's .claude/settings.json hooks.PreToolUse array — never overwrites the file or other hooks. One entry covers both command tools: the matcher spans `Bash|PowerShell`, and each of the two hook elements runs the same script under its own tool's `if` — a foreign-tool `if` never spawns, so each tool needs its own element. The `if` field belongs in the hook object; one placed beside `matcher` is ignored. Both `if` fields anchor on the bare `git` command — a sub-command-anchored pattern misses git global-flag forms such as `git -C <dir> commit` and `git --no-pager commit` — so the script is the real filter: it narrows to real `git commit` invocations, exits 0 on everything else, and gates the rest by agent_type (main session passes; every subagent is routed to /super-bootstrap:commit). Command path is $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR-relative so it resolves from any cwd inside the repo.
